title: Coast Guard Aircrew Dewaters Sailboat and Conducts MEDEVAC on Lake Huron
description:
An aircrew from Coast Guard Air Station Traverse City, Mich., conducts hoists to dewater a sinking sailboat and medically evacuate a man with chest pains 18 nautical miles east of Alpena, Mich., in Lake Huron.

The crew succeeded in the MEDEVAC and dewatering and the sailboat was safely towed to harbor by Coast Guard surface assets.

(U.S. Coast Guard video by Coast Guard Air Station Traverse City/Released)
keywords: Sector Sault Ste. Marie, Air Station Traverse City, Coast Guard 9th District, Lake Huron, medevac, search and rescue
pass_reason: Lake Huron dewatering: calm top-down door-cam with no visible danger; the hoisted man is a chest-pain medevac.
